descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S01 「快捷问题「今天的化验」，病人有化验（医院；养老院变体）」 Preset 'today's labs' on a patient with labs (Hospital; NH variant)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each of the six quick-question presets (today's labs, current medications, pre-round note contents, urgent pending tasks, current diagnosis, symptoms mentioned) returns a correct, patient-specific an …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 4）
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）
  • T4 TC-15 AI checks pass per ground rule 3.2, graded against Vikram's EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md. The substring checks in this matrix are a pre-screen, not that grading.（TFA-94229 AC 2；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Hospital patient with three unitless labs on file; NH variant: resident with two labs

When Ask preset "What were today's labs?"

Then Answer lists the stored labs with their values and trends, adds no other lab and no unit the record does not have

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Every stored value appears; no lab name outside the stored list; no guessed unit on a unitless value (U1, U4 / 3.4). T4: pre-screen only; the 3.2 grade is EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md (Preston)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
